title: Expose peer queue depth and a recent cross-session outbox
outcome: Extend session discovery with per-peer queued-message count and oldest enqueue time, and provide a query for messages sent by the current session over a bounded recent window. This removes resend guessing and lets an agent recover its own send history after context compaction.
acceptance: Callers can query queued count and oldest timestamp for a peer without reading message bodies, and can list their own recent sends with message id, receiver, sequence, time, delivery state, and supersedes metadata. Cross-repository authorization is preserved. Tests cover queued, delivered, failed, expired-window, and restarted-server states.
